## Considered and refused

- p flags: kept 258 (first unit of the part, as 115 in fitt-02 and 189 in fitt-03), 286 (a new speaker answers after a speech ends) and 301 (speech ends, new action). No other unit carries p; none added.
- Splitting 293–300 at the comma after Wedermearce: refused. The unit is exactly eight lines (the ceiling, not over it); the conventions cut only at semicolon or colon; a split would change `t`/`ln`, which I may not touch. A sense-unit does exist (the gnomic clause `gōdfremmendra swylcum gifeþe bið` is separable) so the coordinator may split by hand.
- 272 `gif` as "whether" in i against "if" in l: both fit a clause after wāst; left.
- 258 ‘wordhord’ note ("in the breast like gold in a chest"): cultural gloss, plausible, flagged by its own wording; left.
- 309 i "the mighty king" for se rīca: the note names the king; left.
- 260 gumcynnes: already flagged as a guess; left. 303 and 262 guesses already flagged.
- 316 ‘ārum’/‘ār’ "oar" homograph: no reading needs it; left.
- 286 ombeht/German Amt: etymology stated plainly and correct; left.
